data.content_ref: inline:The reliability trade-off in complex tasks depends on the nature of the error mode: it reduces to a choice between 'omission' (solved by checklists) and 'misinterpretation' (solved by expert intuition). This relation integrates SRC_004 and SRC_005 by proposing that reliability is a function of the error-type distribution; it is refuted if a task with high interdependency (SRC_005) is found to be more reliably solved by a checklist-led panel than by an expert, provided the failure mode is systemic rather than omissive.
